correctness.rationale: PASS: The two explicit character polynomials A=X_1-1 and B=binom(X_1,2)+X_2-X_1 are orthonormal. Counting marked disjoint cycles gives E[(X_1)_i(X_2)_j]=2^{-j} whenever i+2j<=n, zero otherwise. Every quartic mixed term has cycle weight <=8, yielding exact moments (4,2,2,0,3), (4,3,4,4,6), (4,3,5,6,13), (4,3,5,7,15), and (4,3,5,7,16) in regimes n=4,5,6,7,>=8. A positive u^2v^2 coefficient makes phase maximization strict at aligned phases; one-sign-change derivative polynomials give unique positive t_n and strict boundary comparison. Numerator differences prove four strict K_n jumps and exact stabilization n>=8. Independently enumerated conjugacy classes n=4..14 and symbolic derivatives for all five regimes (C1_OK). Finite checks corroborate, not replace, the all-n cycle argument.
